scenarios.fault: The read capability has no runtime binding.
scenarios.repair: Restore the example:catalog.read@1 binding in project.json.

scenarios.fault: The generated manifest revision differs from the expected revision.
scenarios.repair: Regenerate artifacts/catalog.generated.json for the current revision.

scenarios.fault: Two candidate project roots contain a project marker.
scenarios.repair: Select the intended root and remove the legacy candidate.
Grant catalog:read to the fixture identity.

scenarios.fault: The fixture browser lacks the required WebMCP feature.
scenarios.repair: Use a browser with WebMCP support, or select a non-browser adapter.

scenarios.fault: The configured fixture-only credential file is absent.
scenarios.repair: Create credentials/test-auth.json using the fake local fixture value.

scenarios.fault: The configured loopback endpoint is not serving health checks.
scenarios.repair: Run npm run health, then select the repaired fixture on port 8787.

scenarios.fault: No network endpoint is configured, so network evidence is unavailable.
scenarios.repair: Configure a reachable endpoint before requiring a network check.
